cass-address-points.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = DNR Major 8 'Leech Lake River' (HUC8 07010102) polygon from watershed-whole-basin.geojson, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; full 4,776-vertex polygon
cass-address-points.geojson.caveats: DLAN basemap address points. ADDRESS is the point's own street address (the feature's identity). LONGITUDE/LATITUDE dropped (redundant with geometry). FIELD FENCE: owner/taxpayer names, mailing/situs addresses, EMV/valuation, tax amounts/balances, mortgage/payment details and staff/editor names were NOT requested or stored.
